requirement: The route from router r1 to the server network 10.0.2.0/24 is missing. Restore it using the transit link.

proposal.rationale: The server network 10.0.2.0/24 is reachable via the transit link 10.0.12.0/30. Since r1 must use 10.0.12.2 as its only valid next hop, a static route on r1 is required to point to 10.0.2.0/24 via 10.0.12.2. This satisfies the requirement without violating any constraints or introducing new devices or networks.
